column1: This spreadsheet contains 5 tabs of RAW datasets from a CyAI qualitative research study by Drs. Hawthorne and Sabin, published through ACM SIGCITE 2026.
These open source datasets are available for FREE download and Creative Commons 4.0 use from
Open access HTML version of our research paper is available from

Second tab combines ALL ORIGINAL competencies that were gathered through AI assistance for this study with the following fields/columns: source id, domain focus, convergent type, and supportive quote.
Third tab contains all the original COUPLED competencies with all the same fields and the domain focus of either AI or CYBER and convergence type of COUPLED.
Fourth tab contains all the original CONVERGENT competencies with all the same fields and the domain focus of BOTH and convergence type of CONVERGENT.
Fifth tab contains all the original CYBERSECURITY INDEPENDENT competencies with all the same fields & the domain focus of CYBER and convergence type of INDEPENDENT.
Sixth tab contains all the original AI INDEPENDENT competencies with all the same fields & the domain focus of AI and convergence type of INDEPENDENT.
